title: The Upsell Funnel Builder for WooCommerce – Create Upsells, Cross-Sells, Order Bumps, Frequently… (CVE-2026-136995)
description: The Upsell Funnel Builder for WooCommerce WordPress plugin versions up to and including 3.1.7 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the 'form_data' parameter. This vulnerability arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping, allowing unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary scripts. The AJAX endpoint involved is accessible without authentication because the nonce protecting it is publicly exposed on cart, checkout, or shortcode pages. This enables attackers to execute malicious scripts in the context of users visiting the affected pages.
